owner_and_capability: #4072: Settings Platform, Document Rendering, Audit Platform and Delivery Platform declare consumer-owned ports instead of naming domain, projection or workflow owners. The server root binds Care Plan, Identity & Access, Organisation & Tenancy, School Setup, Enrollment, Facilities, Timetable and Workforce. The nine services/scheduler keys remain for #4067.
affected_tables: No schema or ownership changes: existing Settings Platform wizard and setting tables, Audit booking reads, plan export reads and Delivery recipient reads retain their owners.
atomic_cutover: Replace the platform imports and bind the new ports in api in one deployment. Care Plan serves booking-authority-impact through its own HTTP adapter at the same operator route; the root translates its blocked-switch error into settings.BookingAuthorityBlockedError. Settings stores wizard state through generic state shapes. Plan export translation moves from the deleted modules/planexport/compose into api/plan_export.go. Audit reads auditlog.ApprovedBooking and ApprovedBookingOfferingLink through the root adapter. Delivery resolves recipients through its own ports, with Workforce retaining the on-duty rule. Tests move to the root where real owners are composed. No policy rule is added; the stale document-rendering adapter-test rule is deleted. Legacy keys fall from 519 to 494, the composition surface stays 1743, compose LOC falls from 90745 to 90423 and passthroughs from 2397 to 2393. Integration with development at 0ce3ca295ca398ef1591f0fa34514548dda72d86 retains its set-returning Workforce helper; the Delivery root adapter sorts that set into its existing slice port. Reminder vocabulary is pinned independently at both producers, without a Delivery-to-workflow import. After integration the total is 489 legacy keys and 1742 composition targets; six scheduler keys remain under #4072.
